title: Kitchen Sanctuary's Tomato Salmon Pasta
steps: Boil spaghetti in a large pan of salted water for 12 to 13 minutes until fully cooked.
Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and sear seasoned salmon for 3 minutes.
Add diced onion to the empty side of the pan, cook 3 minutes, then add minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in passata, tomato paste, thyme, and sugar, simmering the sauce for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add spiralized courgette to pasta for the last 30 seconds, then drain and reserve cooking water.
Remove salmon skin, flake chunks into the sauce, stir in cream, and toss with pasta and splash of water.
